translations.idiomatic: hand it to Cui Kai."

sentences.zh: 於時冀定數州，頻遭水害，楷上疏曰：

translations.literal: At that time several provinces of Ji and Ding suffered flooding year after year; Kai submitted a memorial saying:
translations.idiomatic: At that time several provinces of Ji and Ding suffered flooding year after year; Kai submitted a memorial saying:

sentences.zh: 臣聞有國有家者，莫不以萬姓為心，故矜傷軫於造次，求瘼結於寢興。

translations.literal: Your servant has heard that those who possess a state and a family take the myriad people as their heart; thus they grieve and pity in haste and seek relief in rising and resting.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant has heard that those who possess a state and a family take the myriad people as their heart; thus they grieve and pity in haste and seek relief in rising and resting.

sentences.zh: 黎民阻飢，唐堯致歎；

translations.literal: When the black-haired people are blocked by hunger, Tang Yao sighed;
translations.idiomatic: When the black-haired people are blocked by hunger, Tang Yao sighed;

sentences.zh: 眾庶斯饉，帝乙罰己。

translations.literal: when the masses suffer famine, Emperor Yi punished himself.
translations.idiomatic: when the masses suffer famine, Emperor Yi punished himself.

sentences.zh: 良以為政與農，實繫民命。

translations.literal: Truly government and agriculture are bound to the people's lives.
translations.idiomatic: Truly government and agriculture are bound to the people's lives.

sentences.zh: 水旱緣茲以得濟，夷險用此而獲安。

translations.literal: Through this flood and drought may be relieved; through this level and steep terrain may be secured.
translations.idiomatic: Through this flood and drought may be relieved; through this level and steep terrain may be secured.

sentences.zh: 頃東北數州，頻年淫雨，長河激浪，洪波汨流，川陸連濤，原隰通望，彌漫不已，汎濫為災。

translations.literal: Recently several provinces of the northeast have had excessive rain year after year. The long river surges in waves; great floods flow in torrents. Rivers and land join in waves; plains and marshes look out on one another. The inundation does not cease and spreads as disaster.
translations.idiomatic: Recently several provinces of the northeast have had excessive rain year after year. The long river surges; great floods flow in torrents. Rivers and land join in waves; plains and marshes look out on one another. The inundation does not cease and spreads as disaster.

sentences.zh: 戶無擔石之儲，家有藜藿之色。

translations.literal: Households have no picul of grain in store; families have the color of wild greens.
translations.idiomatic: Households have no picul of grain in store; families have the color of wild greens.

sentences.zh: 華壤膏腴，變為舄鹵；

translations.literal: Fertile soil and rich land have become salt marshes;
translations.idiomatic: Fertile soil and rich land have become salt marshes;

sentences.zh: 菽麥禾黍，化作雚蒲。

translations.literal: beans, wheat, millet, and hemp have turned into reeds and rushes.
translations.idiomatic: beans, wheat, millet, and hemp have turned into reeds and rushes.

sentences.zh: 斯用痛心徘徊，澘然佇立也。

translations.literal: This makes one grieve in heart and pace about in sorrow.
translations.idiomatic: This makes one grieve in heart and pace about in sorrow.

sentences.zh: 昔洪水為害四載，流於夏書；

translations.literal: In antiquity the flood was a calamity for four years, recorded in the Xia Documents;
translations.idiomatic: In antiquity the flood was a calamity for four years, recorded in the Xia Documents;

sentences.zh: 九土既平攸同，紀自虞誥。

translations.literal: when the nine lands were level all were united, recorded in the Instructions of Yu.
translations.idiomatic: when the nine lands were level all were united, as recorded in the Instructions of Yu.

sentences.zh: 亮由君之勤恤，臣用劬勞，日昃忘餐，宵分廢寢。

translations.literal: It was because the ruler was diligent in care and ministers labored with effort, forgetting meals at sundown and abandoning sleep at midnight.
translations.idiomatic: It was because the ruler was diligent in care and ministers labored with effort, forgetting meals at sundown and abandoning sleep at midnight.

sentences.zh: 伏惟皇魏握圖臨宇，總契裁極，道敷九有，德被八荒，槐階棘路，實維英哲，虎門、麟閣，實曰賢明，天地函和，日月光曜。

translations.literal: I bow and consider Great Wei, holding the chart and facing the realm, mastering the tally and cutting the pole, the Way spread through the nine possessions, virtue covering the eight wilds, the locust-tree steps and thorn paths truly filled with heroes, the tiger gate and unicorn pavilion truly holding the worthy and wise—heaven and earth embrace harmony, sun and moon shine bright.
translations.idiomatic: I bow and consider Great Wei, holding the chart and facing the realm, the Way spread through the nine possessions, virtue covering the eight wilds, the court truly filled with heroes and the worthy—heaven and earth embrace harmony, sun and moon shine bright.

sentences.zh: 自比定冀水潦，無歲不飢；

translations.literal: Since Ding and Ji have had flood and drought, not a year without famine;
translations.idiomatic: Since Ding and Ji have had flood and drought, not a year without famine;

sentences.zh: 幽瀛川河，頻年汎溢。

translations.literal: You and Ying's rivers overflow year after year.
translations.idiomatic: You and Ying's rivers overflow year after year.

sentences.zh: 豈是陽九厄會，百六鍾期，故以人事而然，非為運極。

translations.literal: Is this the yang-nine calamity and the hundred-six cycle, thus happening through human affairs rather than the limit of fortune?
translations.idiomatic: Is this the yang-nine calamity and the hundred-six cycle, thus happening through human affairs rather than the limit of fortune?

sentences.zh: 昔魏國鹹舄，史起哂之；

translations.literal: In former times the state of Wei had salty marshes; Shi Qi laughed at them;
translations.idiomatic: In former times the state of Wei had salty marshes; Shi Qi laughed at them;

sentences.zh: 茲地荒蕪，臣實為耻。

translations.literal: this land is desolate and waste—your servant is truly shamed.
translations.idiomatic: this land is desolate and waste—your servant is truly shamed.

sentences.zh: [7]不揆愚瞽，輒敢陳之。

translations.literal: [7] Not measuring my foolish blindness, I venture to present this.
translations.idiomatic: [7] Not measuring my foolish blindness, I venture to present this.

sentences.zh: 計水之湊下，浸潤無間，九河通塞，屢有變改，不可一準古法，皆循舊隄。

translations.literal: Considering that water flowing down seeps without gap, the nine rivers' passage and blockage have often changed and cannot uniformly follow ancient methods, all tracing old dikes.
translations.idiomatic: Considering that water flowing down seeps without gap, the nine rivers' passage and blockage have often changed and cannot uniformly follow ancient methods, all tracing old dikes.

sentences.zh: 何者？

translations.literal: Why?
translations.idiomatic: Why?

sentences.zh: 河決瓠子，梁楚幾危；

translations.literal: When the river broke at Huzi, Liang and Chu were nearly endangered;
translations.idiomatic: When the river broke at Huzi, Liang and Chu were nearly endangered;

sentences.zh: 宣防既建，水還舊迹。

translations.literal: once Xuan and Fang were built, the water returned to its old course.
translations.idiomatic: once Xuan and Fang were built, the water returned to its old course.

sentences.zh: 十數年間，戶口豐衍。

translations.literal: Within ten-odd years household registers flourished.
translations.idiomatic: Within ten-odd years household registers flourished.

sentences.zh: 又決屯氏，兩川分流，東北數郡之地，僅得支存。

translations.literal: Again it broke at Tunshi; the two rivers divided their flow, and the lands of several northeastern commanderies barely survived.
translations.idiomatic: Again it broke at Tunshi; the two rivers divided their flow, and the lands of several northeastern commanderies barely survived.

sentences.zh: 及下通靈、鳴，水田一路，往昔膏腴，十分病九，邑居凋離，墳井毀滅。

translations.literal: When it opened below to Ling and Ming, one water-rice route—what was once fertile land, nine-tenths sick, settlements scattered, graves and wells destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: When it opened below to Ling and Ming, one water-rice route—what was once fertile land, nine-tenths sick, settlements scattered, graves and wells destroyed.

sentences.zh: 良由水大渠狹，更不開瀉，眾流壅塞，曲直乘之所致也。

translations.literal: Truly because the water was great and the channels narrow, with no further opening for discharge, the many streams blocked and choked, and winding and straight courses multiplied—this was the cause.
translations.idiomatic: Truly because the water was great and the channels narrow, with no further opening for discharge, the many streams blocked and choked, and winding and straight courses multiplied—this was the cause.

sentences.zh: 至若量其逶迤，穿鑿涓澮，[8]分立隄堨，所在疏通，預決其路，令無停蹙。

translations.literal: As for measuring its winding course, piercing and cutting small channels, [8] establishing separate dikes and embankments, clearing wherever blocked, deciding routes in advance so there is no stoppage or choke.
translations.idiomatic: As for measuring its winding course, piercing and cutting small channels, [8] establishing separate dikes and embankments, clearing wherever blocked, deciding routes in advance so there is no stoppage or choke.

sentences.zh: 隨其高下，必得地形，土木參功，務從便省。

translations.literal: Following high and low, one must obtain the terrain; earth and wood share the work, striving for convenience and economy.
translations.idiomatic: Following high and low, one must obtain the terrain; earth and wood share the work, striving for convenience and economy.

sentences.zh: 使地有金隄之堅，水有非常之備。

translations.literal: Let the land have the firmness of golden dikes and the water have extraordinary preparedness.
translations.idiomatic: Let the land have the firmness of golden dikes and the water have extraordinary preparedness.

sentences.zh: 鈎連相注，多置水口，從河入海，遠邇逕通，[9]瀉其墝潟，泄此陂澤。

translations.literal: Hook and link mutual flow, many water outlets set, from river to sea, far and near paths open, [9] draining the saline lowlands, releasing these marshes and pools.
translations.idiomatic: Hook and link mutual flow, many water outlets set, from river to sea, far and near paths open, [9] draining the saline lowlands, releasing these marshes and pools.

sentences.zh: 九月農罷，量役計功，十月昏正，立匠表度。

translations.literal: In the ninth month farming ends; measure labor and calculate work. In the tenth month at dusk set craftsmen and mark degrees.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month farming ends; measure labor and calculate work. In the tenth month at dusk set craftsmen and mark degrees.

sentences.zh: 縣遣能工，麾畫形勢；

translations.literal: Districts send skilled workers to draw the terrain;
translations.idiomatic: Districts send skilled workers to draw the terrain;

sentences.zh: 郡發明使，籌察可否。

translations.literal: commanderies dispatch enlightened envoys to investigate what is feasible.
translations.idiomatic: commanderies dispatch enlightened envoys to investigate what is feasible.

sentences.zh: 審地推岸，辨其脈流；

translations.literal: Examine the land and push the banks, distinguishing the pulse of flow;
translations.idiomatic: Examine the land and push the banks, distinguishing the pulse of flow;

sentences.zh: 樹板分崖，練厥從往。

translations.literal: set boards to divide cliffs and train the course of passage.
translations.idiomatic: set boards to divide cliffs and train the course of passage.

sentences.zh: 別使案檢，分剖是非，[10]瞰睇川原，明審通塞。

translations.literal: Separately send inspectors to divide right and wrong, [10] overlooking rivers and plains, clearly examining passage and blockage.
translations.idiomatic: Separately send inspectors to divide right and wrong, [10] overlooking rivers and plains, clearly examining passage and blockage.

sentences.zh: 當境修治，不勞役遠，終春自罷，未須久功。

translations.literal: Repair within the borders without laboring the distant, ending by spring without need for long work.
translations.idiomatic: Repair within the borders without laboring the distant, ending by spring without need for long work.

sentences.zh: 即以高下營田，因於水陸，水種秔稻，陸藝桑麻。

translations.literal: Then according to high and low establish fields, using water and land—rice planted in water, mulberry and hemp on land.
translations.idiomatic: Then according to high and low establish fields, using water and land—rice planted in water, mulberry and hemp on land.

sentences.zh: 必使室有久儲，門豐餘積。

translations.literal: Surely households will have long stores and gates abundant with surplus grain.
translations.idiomatic: Surely households will have long stores and gates abundant with surplus grain.

sentences.zh: 其實上葉禦災之方，亦為中古井田之利。

translations.literal: In truth this is the method of the upper age for warding off disaster, and also the benefit of well-field in the middle antiquity.
translations.idiomatic: In truth this is the method of the upper age for warding off disaster, and also the benefit of well-field in middle antiquity.

sentences.zh: 即之近事，有可比倫。

translations.literal: Approaching recent affairs, there is comparable precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Approaching recent affairs, there is comparable precedent.

sentences.zh: 江淮之南，地勢洿下，雲雨陰霖，動彌旬月。

translations.literal: South of the Yangtze and Huai the terrain is low and wet; cloudy rain and overcast drizzle often last full months.
translations.idiomatic: South of the Yangtze and Huai the terrain is low and wet; cloudy rain often lasts full months.

sentences.zh: 遙途遠運，惟用舟艫；

translations.literal: Distant roads and far transport rely only on boats;
translations.idiomatic: Distant roads and far transport rely only on boats;

sentences.zh: 南畝畬菑，微事耒耜。

translations.literal: southern fields are burned over; slight work with plow and hoe.
translations.idiomatic: southern fields are burned over; slight work with plow and hoe.

sentences.zh: 而眾庶未為饉色，黔首罕有飢顏。

translations.literal: Yet the masses are not famine-colored; the black-haired people rarely show hungry faces.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the masses are not famine-colored; the common people rarely show hungry faces.

sentences.zh: 豈天德不均，致此偏罰，故是地勢異圖，有茲豐餒。

translations.literal: Is Heaven's virtue unequal, bringing this partial punishment? Thus it is that the terrain differs in map and there is this abundance and scarcity.
translations.idiomatic: Is Heaven's virtue unequal, bringing this partial punishment? Thus the terrain differs in map and there is this abundance and scarcity.

sentences.zh: 臣既鄉居水際，目覩荒殘，每思鄭白，屢想王李。

translations.literal: Your servant, dwelling by the waters, has witnessed the desolation with his own eyes, often thinking of Zheng Bai, repeatedly recalling Wang and Li.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant, dwelling by the waters, has witnessed the desolation with his own eyes, often thinking of Zheng Bai, repeatedly recalling Wang and Li.

sentences.zh: 夙宵不寐，言念皇家，愚誠丹款，實希效力，有心螢爝，乞暫施行。

translations.literal: From early dawn I do not sleep, speaking of the imperial house in my thoughts; my foolish sincerity in red loyalty truly hopes to exert strength, having the heart of a firefly, begging temporary implementation.
translations.idiomatic: From early dawn I do not sleep, speaking of the imperial house in my thoughts; my foolish sincerity truly hopes to exert strength, having the heart of a firefly, begging temporary implementation.

sentences.zh: 使數州士女，無廢耕桑之業；

translations.literal: Let the gentlemen and ladies of several provinces not abandon farming and mulberry;
translations.idiomatic: Let the gentlemen and ladies of several provinces not abandon farming and mulberry;

sentences.zh: 聖世洪恩，有賑飢荒之士。

translations.literal: the sage age's great grace will have gentlemen to relieve famine and waste.
translations.idiomatic: the sage age's great grace will have gentlemen to relieve famine and waste.

sentences.zh: 鄴宰深笑，息自一朝；

translations.literal: The Administrator of Ye will laugh deeply, resting from one morning;
translations.idiomatic: The Administrator of Ye will laugh deeply, resting from one morning;

sentences.zh: 臣之至誠，申於今日。

translations.literal: your servant's utmost sincerity is expressed today.
translations.idiomatic: your servant's utmost sincerity is expressed today.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「頻年水旱為患，黎民阻飢，靜言念之，昃不遑食，[11]鑒此事條，深協在慮。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Flood and drought have been calamities for years; the black-haired people are blocked by hunger. Speaking of it in silence, I have no leisure to eat at sundown, [11] examining these items deeply accords with my thought.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said, "Flood and drought have been calamities for years; the people are blocked by hunger. Speaking of it in silence, I have no leisure to eat at sundown. [11] Examining these items deeply accords with my thought.

sentences.zh: 但計畫功廣，非朝夕可合，宜付外量聞。

translations.literal: But the planned work is broad and cannot be combined in a morning and evening; it should be sent outside for measurement and report.
translations.idiomatic: But the planned work is broad and cannot be combined in a morning and evening; it should be sent outside for measurement and report.

sentences.zh: 」事遂施行。

translations.literal: The matter was then implemented.
translations.idiomatic: The matter was then implemented.

sentences.zh: 楷用功未就，詔還追罷。

translations.literal: Kai's labor was not yet finished when an edict recalled and stopped him.
translations.idiomatic: Kai's labor was not yet finished when an edict recalled and stopped him.

sentences.zh: 久之，京兆王繼為大將軍西討，引楷為司馬。

translations.literal: After a long time, Prince Ji of Jingzhao served as great general on the western campaign and recruited Kai as Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: After a long time, Prince Ji of Jingzhao served as great general on the western campaign and recruited Kai as Marshal.

sentences.zh: 還，轉後將軍、廣平太守。

translations.literal: On his return he was transferred to Rear General and Administrator of Guangping.
translations.idiomatic: On his return he was transferred to Rear General and administrator of Guangping.

sentences.zh: 後葛榮轉盛，諸將拒擊，並皆失利。

translations.literal: Later Ge Rong grew ever stronger; the generals resisted and struck but all lost.
translations.idiomatic: Later Ge Rong grew ever stronger; the generals resisted and struck but all lost.

sentences.zh: 孝昌初，加楷持節、散騎常侍、光祿大夫、兼尚書北道行臺，尋轉軍司。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Xiaochang he was given Kai Bearer of the Staff, Attendant Cavalier-in-Ordinary, Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, Concurrent Master of Writing of the Northern Route Mobile Headquarters; soon he was transferred to Army Supervisor.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Xiaochang he was given Kai Bearer of the Staff, Attendant Cavalier-in-Ordinary, Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, Concurrent Master of Writing of the Northern Route Mobile Headquarters; soon he was transferred to Army Supervisor.

sentences.zh: 未幾，分定相二州四郡置殷州，以楷為刺史，加後將軍。

translations.literal: Before long, dividing Ding and Xiang two provinces and four commanderies, Yinzhou was established, with Kai as inspector and given the additional rank of Rear General.
translations.idiomatic: Before long, dividing Ding and Xiang two provinces and four commanderies, Yinzhou was established, with Kai as inspector and given the additional rank of Rear General.

sentences.zh: 楷至州，表曰：「竊惟殷州地實四衝，居當五裂；

translations.literal: When Kai reached the province he memorialized: "Your servant ventures to consider that Yinzhou's territory is truly a four-way crossroads, situated at a five-part split;
translations.idiomatic: When Kai reached the province he memorialized, "Your servant ventures to consider that Yinzhou's territory is truly a four-way crossroads, situated at a five-part split;

sentences.zh: 西通長山，東漸臣野。

translations.literal: west it connects to the long mountains, east it approaches the subject wilds.
translations.idiomatic: west it connects to the long mountains, east it approaches the subject wilds.

sentences.zh: 頃國路康寧，四方有截，仍聚姦宄，桴鼓時鳴。

translations.literal: Recently the national roads were peaceful and the four quarters were restrained, yet villains still gathered and war drums sounded from time to time.
translations.idiomatic: Recently the national roads were peaceful and the four quarters were restrained, yet villains still gathered and war drums sounded from time to time.

sentences.zh: 況今天長喪亂，妖災間起。

translations.literal: Moreover today the long night of disorder, demonic calamities arise in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover today the long night of disorder, demonic calamities arise in succession.

sentences.zh: 定州逆虜，趑趣北界；

translations.literal: Dingzhou's rebellious barbarians hurry toward the northern border;
translations.idiomatic: Dingzhou's rebellious barbarians hurry toward the northern border;

sentences.zh: 鄴下兇燼，蠶噬腹心。

translations.literal: the fierce flames below Ye gnaw at the heartland.
translations.idiomatic: the fierce flames below Ye gnaw at the heartland.

sentences.zh: 兩處犬羊，勢足并合，城下之戰，匪暮斯朝。

translations.literal: The two packs of dogs and goats have force enough to merge; battle below the walls is not far off, perhaps tomorrow morning.
translations.idiomatic: The two packs of dogs and goats have force enough to merge; battle below the walls is not far off, perhaps tomorrow morning.

sentences.zh: 臣以不武，屬此屏捍，實思効力，以弱敵強，析骸煮弩，固此忠節。

translations.literal: Your servant, though unwarlike, bears this screen and defense and truly thinks to exert strength, using weakness against strength, breaking bones to boil crossbows—such is this loyal resolve.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant, though unwarlike, bears this screen and defense and truly thinks to exert strength, using weakness against strength, breaking bones to boil crossbows—such is this loyal resolve.

sentences.zh: 但基趾造創，庶事茫然，升儲尺刃，聊自未有，雖欲竭誠，莫知攸濟。

translations.literal: But the foundation is newly created and the hundred affairs are obscure; ascending the storehouse with a foot-blade—briefly nothing yet—though wishing to show sincerity, I do not know what will succeed.
translations.idiomatic: But the foundation is newly created and the hundred affairs are obscure; though wishing to show sincerity, I do not know what will succeed.

sentences.zh: 謹列所須兵仗，請垂矜許。

translations.literal: I respectfully list the arms and equipment needed and beg your compassionate grant.
translations.idiomatic: I respectfully list the arms and equipment needed and beg your compassionate grant.

sentences.zh: 必當虎視一方，遏其侵軼，肅清境內，保全所委。

translations.literal: Surely I will glare in one direction, check their invasion and raid, and within the borders make clear and preserve what is entrusted.
translations.idiomatic: Surely I will glare in one direction, check their invasion and raid, and within the borders make clear and preserve what is entrusted.

sentences.zh: 」詔付外量，竟無所給。

translations.literal: An edict ordered outside measurement; in the end nothing was supplied.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered outside measurement; in the end nothing was supplied.

sentences.zh: 葛榮自破章武、廣陽二王之後，鋒不可當。

translations.literal: After Ge Rong broke the Princes of Zhangwu and Guangyang, his edge could not be faced.
translations.idiomatic: After Ge Rong broke the Princes of Zhangwu and Guangyang, his edge could not be faced.

sentences.zh: 初楷將之州，人咸勸留家口，單身述職。

translations.literal: When Kai was first going to the province, people all urged him to leave his household and go alone to take up office.
translations.idiomatic: When Kai was first going to the province, people all urged him to leave his household and go alone to take up office.

sentences.zh: 楷曰：「貪人之祿，憂人之事，如一身獨往，朝廷謂吾有進退之計，將士又誰肯為人固志也？

translations.literal: Kai said: "Taking another's salary, worrying over another's affairs—if I go alone, the court will think I have a plan to advance or retreat, and what officer would be willing to hold fast for others?"
translations.idiomatic: Kai said, "Taking another's salary means worrying over another's affairs. If I go alone, the court will think I plan to flee, and what officer would hold fast for others?"

sentences.zh: 」遂合家赴州。

translations.literal: He then brought the whole family to the province.
translations.idiomatic: He then brought his whole family to the province.

sentences.zh: 三年春，賊勢已逼，或勸減小弱以避之，乃遣第四女、第三兒夜出。

translations.literal: In the third year spring the bandit force had already pressed close. Some urged reducing the weak and small to avoid them, and he sent his fourth daughter and third son out by night.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year spring the bandit force had already pressed close. Some urged sending away the weak, and he sent his fourth daughter and third son out by night.

sentences.zh: 既而召僚屬共論之，咸曰：「女郎出嫁之女，郎君小未勝兵，留之無益，去復何損。

translations.literal: Then he summoned his staff to discuss it. All said: "The young lady is a married-out daughter; the young master is small and not yet fit for arms—keeping them is no benefit, sending them away is no loss.
translations.idiomatic: Then he summoned his staff to discuss it. All said, "The young lady is already married out; the young master is too small for arms—keeping them is no benefit, sending them away is no loss.

sentences.zh: 且使君在城，家口尚多，足固將士之意，竊不足為疑。

translations.literal: Moreover the lord is in the city and household members are still many, enough to firm the officers' hearts—your servant finds no grounds for doubt."
translations.idiomatic: Moreover you are in the city and household members are still many, enough to firm the officers' hearts—we find no grounds for doubt."

sentences.zh: 」楷曰：「國家豈不知城小力弱也，置吾死地，令吾死耳！

translations.literal: Kai said: "Does the state not know the city is small and strength weak? It placed me in a death land, intending me to die!
translations.idiomatic: Kai said, "Does the state not know the city is small and strength weak? It placed me in a death land, intending me to die!

sentences.zh: 一朝送免兒女，將謂吾心不固。

translations.literal: If in one morning I send away my children, they will say my heart is not firm.
translations.idiomatic: If in one morning I send away my children, they will say my heart is not firm.

sentences.zh: 虧忠全愛，臧獲耻之，況吾荷國重寄也。

translations.literal: To fail in loyalty and complete love—even slaves would be shamed by it, how much more one who bears the state's heavy trust.
translations.idiomatic: To fail in loyalty and complete love—even slaves would be shamed, how much more one who bears the state's heavy trust.

sentences.zh: 」遂命追還。

translations.literal: He then ordered them pursued and brought back.
translations.idiomatic: He then ordered them pursued and brought back.

sentences.zh: 州既新立，了無禦備之具。

translations.literal: The province was newly established and wholly lacked defensive preparations.
translations.idiomatic: The province was newly established and wholly lacked defensive preparations.

sentences.zh: 及賊來攻，楷率力抗拒，強弱勢懸，每勒兵士撫厲之，莫不爭奮，咸稱：「崔公尚不惜百口，吾等何愛一身！

translations.literal: When bandits came to attack, Kai led strength in resistance. Strong and weak were far apart in power; each time he urged the soldiers and encouraged them, none did not struggle fiercely. All said: "Lord Cui does not spare a hundred mouths—why should we love one body!"
translations.idiomatic: When bandits came to attack, Kai led resistance. Strong and weak were far apart; each time he urged the soldiers, none failed to struggle fiercely. All said, "Lord Cui does not spare a hundred mouths—why should we love one body!"

sentences.zh: 」[12]速戰半旬，死者相枕。

translations.literal: [12] After rapid battle for half a month, the dead lay pillow to pillow.
translations.idiomatic: [12] After rapid battle for half a month, the dead lay pillow to pillow.

sentences.zh: 力竭城陷，楷執節不屈，賊遂害之，時年五十一。

translations.literal: Strength exhausted, the city fell. Kai held his staff and would not bend; the bandits then killed him, aged fifty-one.
translations.idiomatic: Strength exhausted, the city fell. Kai held his staff and would not bend; the bandits killed him, aged fifty-one.

sentences.zh: 長子士元舉茂才，平州錄事參軍、假征虜將軍、防城都督，隨楷之州，州陷，亦戰歿。

translations.literal: His eldest son Shiyuan was recommended as maocai, Recording Staff Officer of Pingzhou, acting General Who Punishes the Barbarians, Defense Commander, following Kai to the province; when the province fell he also died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: His eldest son Shiyuan was recommended as maocai, Recording Staff Officer of Pingzhou, acting General Who Punishes the Barbarians, Defense Commander, following Kai to the province; when the province fell he also died in battle.

sentences.zh: 楷兄弟父子，並死王事，朝野傷歎焉。

translations.literal: Kai's brothers, sons, and father all died in the king's service; court and country mourned and sighed.
translations.idiomatic: Kai's brothers, sons, and father all died in the king's service; court and country mourned and sighed.

sentences.zh: 贈使持節、散騎常侍、鎮軍將軍、定州刺史。

translations.literal: He was posthumously granted Bearer of the Staff, Attendant Cavalier-in-Ordinary, General Who Pacifies the Army, and Inspector of Dingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously granted Bearer of the Staff, Attendant Cavalier-in-Ordinary, General Who Pacifies the Army, and inspector of Dingzhou.

sentences.zh: 永熙中，又特贈侍中、都督冀定相三州諸軍事、驃騎大將軍、儀同三司、冀州刺史。

translations.literal: In the Yongxi era he was again specially posthumously granted Attendant, Commander of all military affairs of the three provinces of Ji, Ding, and Xiang, Grand General of Rapid Cavalry, Equal in Honor to the Three Excellencies, and Inspector of Jizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yongxi era he was again specially posthumously granted Attendant, commander of military affairs of Ji, Ding, and Xiang provinces, Grand General of Rapid Cavalry, Equal in Honor to the Three Excellencies, and inspector of Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 士元弟士謙、士約，並歿關西。

translations.literal: Shiyuan's younger brothers Shiqian and Shiyue both died in the lands west of the passes.
translations.idiomatic: Shiyuan's younger brothers Shiqian and Shiyue both died in the lands west of the passes.

sentences.zh: 士約弟士順，儀同開府行參軍。

translations.literal: Shiyue's younger brother Shishun was Mobile Staff Officer of the Office Equal to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: Shiyue's younger brother Shishun was Mobile Staff Officer of the Office Equal to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 士元息勵德，武定中，司徒城局參軍。

translations.literal: Shiyuan's son Lide, in the Wuding era, was Staff Officer of the City Bureau of the Minister of State.
translations.idiomatic: Shiyuan's son Lide served as Staff Officer of the City Bureau of the Minister of State during the Wuding era.

sentences.zh: 史臣曰：鄭羲機識明悟，為時所許，懿兄弟風尚，俱有可觀，故能並當榮遇，其濟美矣。

translations.literal: The historiographer says: Zheng Xi's resourceful insight and clear understanding were acknowledged by the age; the Yi brothers' bearing and conduct were both admirable, and thus they could all meet with honor—how they enhanced the family's beauty!
translations.idiomatic: The historiographer says: Zheng Xi's resourceful insight and clear understanding were acknowledged by the age; the Yi brothers' bearing and conduct were both admirable, and thus they could all meet with honor—how they enhanced the family's beauty!

sentences.zh: 嚴祖穢薄，忝其家世。

translations.literal: Yanzu's foul baseness disgraced his family line.
translations.idiomatic: Yanzu's foul baseness disgraced his family line.

sentences.zh: 幼儒令問促年，伯猷賄以敗業，惜乎！

translations.literal: Youru's fine reputation cut short in years; Boyou's bribes ruined his career—pity!
translations.idiomatic: Youru's fine reputation cut short in years; Boyou's bribes ruined his career—pity!

sentences.zh: 崔辯器業著聞，位不遠到。

translations.literal: Cui Bian's talent and achievement were renowned; his rank did not reach far.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Bian's talent and achievement were renowned; his rank did not reach far.

sentences.zh: 逸經明行高，籍甚太和之日，德優官薄，仍世恨之。

translations.literal: Yi's classics were clear and conduct lofty, greatly esteemed in the Taihe days; virtue was superior but office thin—a regret through the generations.
translations.idiomatic: Yi's classics were clear and conduct lofty, greatly esteemed in the Taihe days; virtue was superior but office thin—a regret through the generations.

sentences.zh: 模雄壯之烈，楷忠貞之操，殺身成義，臨難如歸。

translations.literal: Mo's fierce heroic valor and Kai's loyal steadfast conduct—dying to accomplish righteousness, facing hardship as if returning home.
translations.idiomatic: Mo's fierce heroic valor and Kai's loyal steadfast conduct—dying to accomplish righteousness, facing hardship as if returning home.

sentences.zh: 非大丈夫亦何能以若此！

translations.literal: If not a great man, how could one act thus!
translations.idiomatic: If not a great man, how could one act thus!
